name: Cooking With Karl
source:
8 June is Claudia's birthday. Before Karl leaves for his next mission, he plans to make a homemade gift for his lover.

With the Chef's guidance, will Karl be able to make Claudia's favorite dish?

[Edited from [url=https://nabakisan.itch.io/cooking-with-karl]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
6月8日是克劳迪娅的生日。在卡尔出发执行下一个任务之前，他计划为他的爱人制作一份自制的礼物。

在厨师的指导下，卡尔能做出克劳迪娅最喜欢的菜吗？

[编辑自[url=https://nabakisan.itch.io/cooking-with-karl]itch.io[/url]]
